production_guard_notes: Fresh seed required; do not reuse producer UUID already exercised and deleted.
Producer must pin destination/current image and ownership on each SQL read/cleanup.
Cleanup transaction must lock exact row and reject submitted/exam_session/nonzero children; do not delete unexpected children.
The aggregate outcome must hash-reference child JSON and trace/screenshot files, compare exact public/Git asset hashes and inspect API/SQL transitions.
No production-user-outcome.json is generated by this harness.
